annotations.title: Evaluate Single-Customer Stripe Basil Ghost Usage

description: Evaluate whether a specific customer's AI or API usage event constitutes unpaid ghost usage across multi-subscription Stripe 2025-03-31.basil state, enforcing fail-closed pagination (has_more must be explicitly false) and configurable 0-14 day dunning grace windows. Executes as a stateless, read-only entitlement evaluator with zero side effects. Returns structuredContent containing ok, mode, statelessEphemeralAudit, tenantId, and evaluation (isGhostLeak, isGhostUsage, reason). Use this tool for real-time per-customer entitlement gating; use revclamp_audit_revenue_leakage for batch multi-customer portfolio audits.

currentPeriodEnd.description: Optional camelCase alias for current_period_end (Unix epoch seconds, epoch milliseconds, or ISO-8601 string).

currentPeriodEndSec.description: Optional flat subscription current_period_end in Unix epoch integer seconds.

current_period_end.description: Optional flat subscription current_period_end (Unix epoch seconds, epoch milliseconds, or ISO-8601 string).

customerId.description: Stripe customer identifier to evaluate (format example: 'cus_9s6XKzkNRiz8i3', max 64 chars).

demo.description: Optional simulation flag (boolean) for deterministic ghost-usage preview.

dunningGracePeriodDays.description: Dunning grace window in integer days (valid range: 0 to 14, default: 3) after latest_invoice_failed_at during which past_due subscriptions remain entitled.

latestInvoiceFailedAtSec.description: Optional flat latest_invoice_failed_at timestamp in Unix epoch integer seconds for past_due grace evaluation.

latest_invoice_failed_at.description: Optional flat latest_invoice_failed_at timestamp (Unix epoch seconds, epoch milliseconds, or ISO-8601 string).

occurredAt.description: Optional usage event timestamp as ISO-8601 string, Unix epoch seconds, or Unix epoch milliseconds.

occurredAtSec.description: Optional alias for usageTimestampSec: Unix epoch timestamp in integer seconds (e.g. 1761264000) when the usage event occurred (used when usageTimestampSec is omitted).

occurred_at.description: Optional snake_case alias for occurredAt (ISO-8601 string, Unix epoch seconds, or Unix epoch milliseconds).

subscriptionStatus.description: Optional flat Stripe subscription status shorthand ('active', 'trialing', 'past_due', 'canceled', 'unpaid', 'incomplete', 'incomplete_expired', 'paused') when subscriptions is omitted.

subscriptions.description: Optional Stripe customer subscriptions payload: either a Stripe list object ({ data: [...], has_more: false }) or a raw array of up to 50 subscription objects containing id, status ('active', 'trialing', 'past_due', 'canceled', 'unpaid'), current_period_end, or items.data[].current_period_end in Unix seconds.

subscriptionsHasMore.description: Pagination completeness flag (boolean). Must be explicitly set to false when passing a raw subscriptions array so RevClamp can verify no active subscription was truncated on a later page.

timestamp.description: Optional alias for occurredAt (ISO-8601 string, Unix epoch seconds, or Unix epoch milliseconds).

usageEvent.description: Optional metered usage event object containing customer_id (or stripe_customer_id), event_name, and occurred_at (or occurred_at_sec).

usageTimestampSec.description: Optional Unix epoch timestamp in integer seconds (e.g. 1761264000) when the AI/API usage event occurred (defaults to current server Unix timestamp if omitted).

name: revclamp_evaluate_ghost_usage
title: Evaluate Single-Customer Stripe Basil Ghost Usage
